title: The Halfway Diner - Part 1
premise: You start your first night shift at the Halfway Diner. night-cook (Dot) gives you three rules: cook every order and never ask who placed it, never tell a customer your name, and at 3:33 stay behind the counter. Then she says 'same as last night, hon', though it is your first shift. trucker (Hank) sits at his stool without touching his food. pajama-kid (Theo) walks in barefoot at 2 AM and calls you by name.
